script:
Li Meimei (The Real Killer)
Li Meimei was originally a bar girl in a certain town, named Chen Hongdeng. Three years ago, Yao Qianshu, the pawn shop owner in town, suddenly found Chen Hongdeng and asked her to approach the newcomer Wang Er. Chen Hongdeng often received such tasks and didn't think much of it, so she approached Wang Er when he was drinking. After a few shots of strong liquor, Wang Er became confused and took Chen Hongdeng to a hotel by the bar to have relations. From Wang Er, Chen Hongdeng learned that he was originally from a prestigious family but was kicked out due to some incident, and because the family still wouldn't let them go, they fled to this place. Chen Hongdeng told Yao Qianshu about this and then didn't concern herself with the matter anymore.
Two years ago, while Chen Hongdeng was working at the bar, a customer came. This person had half his face severely burned, looking quite terrifying. Through conversation, Chen Hongdeng learned that this person was named Li Changqing, who had just moved from out of town and bought a villa in town, planning to settle down. Chen Hongdeng immediately became interested in this wealthy patron and used all her skills to win his favor. Sure enough, before long Li Changqing developed special feelings for Chen Hongdeng and even paid to buy out her contract, hoping she would live with him. Moreover, since the name Chen Hongdeng had a bad reputation in town, he hoped she could change her name to Li Meimei. Being able to escape this zombie-like profession, she was naturally overjoyed and went home with Li Changqing.
Li Meimei came to live at Li Changqing's house, and Li Changqing even gave her a separate room. Li Changqing told her he hoped she would stay home during the day and not go out - if people discovered her, it would be very embarrassing for him. He would hire a nanny to take care of his daily meals and living during the day. Li Meimei initially didn't mind and agreed. But as time went on, Li Meimei couldn't stand it anymore - living like a thief every day was too difficult. She asked Li Changqing but was refused, and she was even often locked inside by Li Changqing. This vampire-like life went on longer and longer. Li Meimei finally couldn't bear it and began to hate Li Changqing. At the same time, she realized that Li Changqing's fear of her being recognized wasn't that simple - maybe she knew something that Li Changqing didn't dare tell outsiders. So she began to act crazy and foolish, playing the role of someone who knew nothing. Apart from these things, Li Changqing still cared for her quite a bit, buying her various jewelry and clothes, and even giving her a car.
To find Li Changqing's weakness, Li Meimei began searching through his things. She found a photograph in Li Changqing's wardrobe - a photo of a man and woman. The man looked very much like Li Changqing but had no scars on his face, probably what Li Changqing looked like before being injured. She carefully recalled and suddenly discovered that Li Changqing looked almost exactly like Wang Er from back then. She was very angry - why did Yao Qianshu make her approach this pervert back then, leading to her current predicament?
Li Changqing went out for walks almost every night, rain or shine, which puzzled Li Meimei. Having seen too many underground affairs, Li Meimei realized this could be leverage against Li Changqing. So when she had the chance to go out at night, Li Meimei would sometimes secretly follow Li Changqing, but found that he didn't visit any secret places - he just wandered around the streets and alleys, occasionally driving around.
One night, Li Meimei came to Yao Qianshu's pawn shop and questioned him about why he had made her approach Wang Er back then. Yao Qianshu was very angry and told her Wang Er was long dead, then viciously scolded her about her past as a prostitute. Although she was very puzzled about who Li Changqing really was, being reminded of her painful past by Yao Qianshu made her extremely angry, and she slammed the door and left.
On the evening of August 20th, Li Changqing returned home. His emotions were extremely strange that day - he was screaming, crying, and throwing things wildly at home. Li Meimei symbolically comforted him but was secretly gloating.
[August 30th Evening]
Li Changqing left at 10:20 PM. Li Meimei changed into a black cloak and followed him. She found Li Changqing got in his car and sat there for a long time before setting off. Li Meimei realized this seemed to be an unusual night and drove to follow.
Around 10:40, she followed Li Changqing to Yao Qianshu's house, where Li Changqing stopped. Then it suddenly started pouring rain, and she couldn't see clearly. A car passed by her, and she worried it might be Li Changqing returning, so she followed it.
At 11:00, they came to the clock tower on the south side of town. That car turned a corner and disappeared. She turned off her headlights and parked in the center by the clock tower, but found a figure walking toward her. She was terrified, thinking Li Changqing had discovered her, so she took out the pistol from the car's glove compartment. This person got in the car, but it turned out to be Yao Qianshu. Yao Qianshu got in and said, "Did you bring the money?" Seeing no response, he turned around and found it was Li Meimei. Yao Qianshu's face immediately changed, and he cursed Li Meimei. Already frightened and now furious, Li Meimei shot Yao Qianshu in the head just as he opened the car door to get out, then quickly threw down the gun, got out of the car, and ran.
She hid under a tree by the roadside. Suddenly a car came, and the person in the car got into her car and drove away. With her mind in chaos, she rushed to that person's car and drove off.
At 11:15, she returned home. Li Changqing wasn't back yet. She threw her rain-soaked clothes in the dirty clothes basket and went to wash up. Not long after, Li Changqing returned. After Li Changqing went to his room, Li Meimei took the dirty clothes from the basket and put them back on, climbed out the window, and found her car parked at the front door with the doors wide open and a faint trail of blood leading to the orchard across the road. She pulled out the car keys, closed the car doors, and followed the blood trail into the orchard. After searching, she indeed found hastily buried traces with a shovel thrown nearby. Li Meimei knew that if people discovered that car with the body was hers, she would definitely be implicated. Just as she was about to dig up the body, a gunshot rang out, and a bullet flew past her, scratching her arm. She quickly hid behind a fruit tree. After waiting for a while and hearing no more sounds, she dug up the body and dragged it home, took off all the mud-covered clothes, poured gasoline on them and burned them, then stuffed the body into the car she had driven back, only to discover it was neighbor Zhang's car. She smashed a hole in the car window, smeared blood inside the car, and afraid it would be too obvious parked on the roadside, she parked it in Li Changqing's garage. Then she cleaned the bloodstains from her own car and parked it back in her own garage. After returning home, she simply treated her wound, threw away the cloth used to wipe the blood, and rested.
The day after the incident, August 31st, Li Meimei took advantage of Nanny Jia not paying attention and stuffed neighbor Zhang's car keys into Nanny Jia's jacket pocket. When Li Changqing left, she secretly put the fired gun in Li Changqing's room and took the unfired one back to her own room.
On the morning of September 1st, Li Meimei felt everything was ready and pretended to ask Nanny Jia to get kerosene lamp oil. The oil was stored in the garage. When Nanny Jia opened the garage, she discovered Yao Qianshu's body.
You are the killer - don't expose yourself.
Only Clue (Not actively exposing +10 points):
Li Changqing came near the deceased's house on the night of the incident.
acts_goal: Don't actively expose that Li Changqing came near the deceased's house on the night of the incident.
